caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal Nos. 392 & 393 of 2003
lawyer:
Khandaker Mahbubuddin Ahmed, Senior Advocate, instructed by Md SR Khoshnabish, Advocate-on-Record—For the Petitioner. 
Not represented—Respondents.
parties:
Parveen Sultana ----- Petitioner 
Vs.
Sahera Khatun and another ----- Respondents
full_judgment: 3. The defendant No. 1 of both the suits contested the suits by filing written statements contending; inter alia, that the suits were not maintainable and were barred by limitation and also barred by the provision of section 42 of the Specific Relief Act as the plaintiff is out of possession. The case of the defendant in both the suits is that the land covering an area of 0.768 acre of CS Plot No. 15 and CS Khatian No. 3320 corresponding to SA Khatian No. 2862 and SA Plot Nos. 5150 and 5550 belonged to the plaintiff and SA record was prepared in her name. In October, 1981, she expressed her desire to transfer the suit land through Shawkat Ali. Accordingly on receipt of Taka 20,000 through cheque, she executed an agreement on 1-11-1981. At the time of such execution, her close relatives were present. Thereafter, on 9-2-1982 she executed the impugned kabala deeds on receipt of the balance consideration money through cheque and in cash. The defendant purchased the said land in her name by one deed and in the benami of Shawkat Ali by another deed. She took delivery of possession of the entire land, after her purchase. After registration of Waqf deed on 16-2-1953 in respect of the suit land and other lands the same was not enrolled as waqf property. Mendi Mia, the Waqif and firs mutwalli of the Estate, transferred one-third share of the land to Sahera Khatun, daughter by his divorced wife. After the death of Mendi Mia, Mogol Bibi, his second wife, became the owner of rest two-third share of the property. The plaintiff filed an application before the Waqf Administrator seeking permission to execute and register fresh deed in favour of defendant No.1. The Waqf Administrator permitted the plaintiff to transfer he said land after re-fixing the price of the same but the plaintiff without re-fixing the price of the suit land, executed and registered another deed in respect of the suit land in favour of the defendant No.1 on 29-5-1984. She also handed over the papers relating to her appointment as Mutwalli to defendant-petitioner. The story of taking the signature of the plaintiff fraudulently is false. One Zahiruddin was appointed as caretaker and licensee in respect of some of the premises but he did not perform his duty as per instructions of the defendant-petitioner. So, the petitioner instituted a suit for his eviction and got a decree and evicted Zahiruddin through Court on 21-4-1988 and Ansars were deputed to protect her possession. Sahera Khatun and her party men forcibly demolished the boundary wall constructed by the petitioner who filed Criminal Case No. 34(4)88 which is pending. The plaintiff filed Miscellaneous Case No. 35 of 1988 seeking restoration of possession of the suit land as per provision of Order XXI, rule 100 of the Code of Civil Procedure and the suit is dismissed. The petitioner instituted Title Suit No. 18 of 1988 against Waqf Administrator and heirs of Shawkat Ali for permanent injunction and got a decree. The petitioner paid gas bill, electricity bill, rent, etc. On prayer of Sahera Khatun the name of Mogol Bibi was deleted and Sahera Khatun was added as plaintiff in the suit.
